profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company (Nasdaq: ZS) that describes itself as a leading cloud enterprise security provider focused on helping global businesses adopt zero trust for secure digital transformation. Its core platform, the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange, is designed to connect users, devices, and applications without relying on traditional network perimeter models. The company describes its infrastructure as the largest security cloud on the planet and emphasizes a unified, zero-trust framework for governing data lineage and agent-to-agent interactions.

The company's primary AI product, tracked on this site as Zscaler AI, sits within the Security and Identity AI category and encompasses cloud security AI capabilities delivered through a Security Service Edge platform, including data loss prevention and AI traffic inspection. Zscaler also maintains a partner and integration ecosystem intended to support enterprise deployments and cloud operations.

The held facts confirm Zscaler is a for-profit public company with SEC CIK number 0001713683 and ticker symbol ZS. No litigation or MCP server entries are currently recorded for the company in this site's registry.
